profile.summary: Chartered Accountant with statutory audit and month-end close experience in manufacturing.

bullets: Owned the month-end close for 2 plants, cutting close time from 9 days to 6 days.
Reconciled 14 bank accounts and vendor ledgers in SAP FICO every month.
Prepared GST returns and supported the Ind AS financial statements audit.
Audited 11 mid-size manufacturing clients under statutory audit engagements.

jd.title: Financial Analyst (FP&A)
jd.text: Seeking a Financial Analyst for FP&A: budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, month-end close support and management reporting in Excel and SAP. CA or MBA Finance preferred, 3-5 years of experience. Power BI a plus.

output.summary: Finance Executive with 5+ years of professional experience in month-end close, GST and Ind AS reporting, seeking the Financial Analyst (FP&A) role. Strong analytical skills with hands-on Excel and SAP FICO expertise.

bullets: Owned the month-end close for 2 plants, cutting close time from 9 days to 6 days.
Reconciled 14 bank accounts and vendor ledgers monthly in SAP FICO with zero audit exceptions.
Led variance analysis and forecasting for the Ind AS financial statements, driving budget accuracy.
Performed statutory audits of 11 mid-size manufacturing companies.

profile_improvement_tips: Build budgeting and forecasting experience, for example by supporting your plant's annual budget cycle.
output.growth_note: You meet 2 of the 4 core requirements (month-end close, SAP, Excel). Building budgeting, forecasting and Power BI experience would strengthen your fit.
